correctness.rationale: The source identifies \(Y_m=(K_m\cup A)(2m+15,0)\) as \(\Sigma_2(D(1-m))\) and gives linking number \(m+2\). Integral surgery therefore presents \(H_1(Y_m;\mathbb Z)\) by \(L_m=\begin{pmatrix}2m+15&m+2\\m+2&0\end{pmatrix}\). The first Smith invariant is \(\gcd(2m+15,m+2)=\gcd(11,m+2)\), while the product of the invariants is \(|\det L_m|=(m+2)^2\). This proves the stated decomposition for every \(m\ge1\). The determinant agrees with the independent determinant stated for the branch link in the source.
